domain_focus: Retail: Value proof and benefit realization
activation_conditions: Use when an initiative claims productivity, cost, revenue, or risk value.
lens_questions: What metric proves value? Who owns the baseline? What period and population are measured?
lens_forbidden_claims: Do not call value realized without measured baseline, time period, owner, and adoption evidence.

domain_focus: Retail: Process, role, and decision redesign
activation_conditions: Use when AI or automation is proposed without clear work redesign.
lens_questions: Which decisions change? Which workflows change? Which roles, controls, and handoffs change?
lens_forbidden_claims: Do not imply AI success from tool deployment alone.

domain_focus: Retail: Data quality, lineage, semantic ownership, and evidence controls
activation_conditions: Use when answers depend on systems, analytics, AI readiness, or board-grade reporting.
lens_questions: What is the system of record? Who owns the definition? What freshness and lineage are certified?
lens_forbidden_claims: Do not recommend scale when source data ownership, lineage, or quality evidence is absent.

domain_focus: Retail: Commercial value, renewal exposure, and vendor dependency
activation_conditions: Use when spend, contract, sourcing, renewal, or platform consolidation is in scope.
lens_questions: What is the committed spend? What renews next? What business capability depends on the vendor?
lens_forbidden_claims: Do not make sourcing recommendations without renewal, owner, service, risk, and pricing-basis evidence.
